title: Small habits of couples who last

slides.title: Small habits of *couples who last*
slides.sub: None of them take more than a minute.

slides.title: Say *good morning.*
slides.body: Even on busy days. A two-word text still counts.

slides.title: Ask about the *small stuff.*
slides.body: How was the meeting? Did the bus show up on time?

slides.title: Say *thank you* for normal things.
slides.body: Dinner. The dishes. Remembering your coffee order.

slides.title: Go to bed *at the same time.*
slides.body: Even twice a week. The pillow talk is the point.

slides.title: Fight the *problem*, not each other.
slides.body: It’s the two of you against the issue. Always.

slides.title: Keep a *running joke.*
slides.body: The thing only you two find funny. Protect it.

slides.title: Save this *and start tomorrow.*
slides.sub: Pick one habit. Do it for a week. Watch what changes.
